title: Contents Packout & Storage Declared-Value Coverage Charge per Storage Period
content:
**Calculation clause.** The coverage line is charged while its period runs, and the coverage period being billed is the storage period, counted in whole periods of the tier's period length from the custody start date, that contains the day the line is charged. The value covered is the declared value recorded on the job, except that items listed on signed disposal authorizations leave the coverage, because they are never compensated: when the job's signed disposal authorizations list at least one item, the value covered is found by taking the boxes packed less the items listed on signed disposal authorizations, each listed item counting as one packed box, dividing that difference by the boxes packed, and multiplying the declared value by that ratio. The standard declared-value coverage line for a period is the value covered times the tier's valuation percentage, divided by one hundred, for the full period, rounded to the cent, half up.

This Contents Packout & Storage clause prices the declared-value coverage line of a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job. For a declared-value coverage line priced under this clause, and only for such a line, the amount is figured as stated here; every declared-value coverage line not priced under it is still billed each period at the tier's valuation percentage of the declared value, rounded to the cent, half up.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Source |
|---|---|
| Declared value | the value the customer declared at signing, recorded on the job |
| Boxes packed | the job record at custody start |
| Items listed on signed disposal authorizations | the item counts on the job's disposal authorizations in signed status |
| Valuation percentage and period length | the tier figures on the product's custody terms and storage rate card |

## How the amounts combine

The amounts are combined in one order: the coverage rate is the valuation percentage with every percentage added to it; the value covered is multiplied by that coverage rate and divided by one hundred; any amount figured per item or on the declared value is added to that product; the resulting sum is multiplied by any factor and then by the fraction of the period, and that figure is rounded once to the cent, half up, as the line amount. Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before rounding, so that a figure lying on a half cent always rounds up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; a percentage of 0.5 is used for illustration, not a tier figure)

| Declared value | Boxes packed | Items on signed disposal authorizations | Value covered | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12,000.00 | 200 | none | 12,000.00 | 12,000.00 times 0.5 divided by one hundred, 60.00 |
| 12,000.00 | 200 | 50 | 12,000.00 times 150 divided by 200, 9,000.00 | 45.00 |
